documents.t: Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart

sportsdataverse.basketball.feb — 11 endpoints. Note: Legal notice: the FEB's aviso legal asserts intellectual-property rights over the site's content and databases (the EU database right). It has no explicit scraping clause and robots.txt returns 404 on both hosts, but SportsDataverse has not ruled on it: fetching on your own machine is fine; a published data release or a hosted mirror needs a legal sign-off first. Note: Unofficial and unsupported: the LiveStats API is the federation's own widget backend, not a documented public API. It needs a bearer JWT, which is public: feb_runtime reads it from the site's home page at run time, keeps it in memory for the process (24 h validity) and never prints, logs or writes it. Note: Coverage: the game routes answer from 2020-21 (Liga Femenina Endesa from its first game; Primera FEB from 2021-03-12, so its earlier 2020-21 games answer 404, as do all earlier seasons). 2020-21 play-by-play is text only. The schedule pages go back to 1996-97 (season=1997). Segunda FEB and the youth and Tercera FEB groups share the same routes; group is the site's menu group (1 Primera FEB, 2 Segunda FEB, 4 Liga Femenina Endesa). Note: Seasons are END years everywhere in this package (season=2027 is 2026-27); the site's own t is the START year, so the runtime sends t = season - 1 (t=2026 is 2026-27).
